name: Pharantis
ability: Pharaoh's Curse (its own: once per battle, survives a knockout at half health with +2 Attack and Sp. Atk) / Torrent (hidden)
look: a nimble mantis pharaoh: a gold-and-blue striped headcloth with a golden cobra, fierce orange eyes, a blue segmented body with a gold medallion, raised banded scythe arms ending in golden crook hooks, a pleated gold kilt and long black legs with silver claws
entry: It rules the river valleys with a crook of gold at the end of each scythe, and moves so fast its foes never see it strike. Those who think they have defeated it soon learn about the pharaoh's curse.
how: Evolve Sarcoon at level 36. Learns Liquidation when it evolves.
